label: [Windows] CMake Configure
command: & 'C:/Program Files/Microsoft Visual Studio/2022/Community/Common7/Tools/Launch-VsDevShell.ps1' -Arch amd64 -SkipAutomaticLocation; cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_MAKE_PROGRAM='C:/Users/berg/development/bin/ninja.exe' -DZ_VCPKG_POWERSHELL_PATH='C:/Users/berg/AppData/Local/Microsoft/WindowsApps/pwsh.exe' -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE='../../vcpkg/scripts/buildsystems/vcpkg.cmake' -DVCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET=x64-windows-static; Copy-Item build/compile_commands.json .

label: [Windows] CMake Configure + Build
command: & 'C:/Program Files/Microsoft Visual Studio/2022/Community/Common7/Tools/Launch-VsDevShell.ps1' -Arch amd64 -SkipAutomaticLocation; cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_MAKE_PROGRAM='C:/Users/berg/development/bin/ninja.exe' -DZ_VCPKG_POWERSHELL_PATH='C:/Users/berg/AppData/Local/Microsoft/WindowsApps/pwsh.exe' -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE='../../vcpkg/scripts/buildsystems/vcpkg.cmake' -DVCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET=x64-windows-static; Copy-Item build/compile_commands.json . && cmake --build build --parallel

label: [Windows] CMake Clean
command: & 'C:/Program Files/Microsoft Visual Studio/2022/Community/Common7/Tools/Launch-VsDevShell.ps1' -Arch amd64 -SkipAutomaticLocation; cmake --build build --target clean

label: [Linux] CMake Clean + Build
command: direnv exec . sh -c 'cmake --build build --target clean && cmake --build build'

label: [Linux] CMake Reconfigure + Build
command: direnv exec . sh -c 'cmake --fresh -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build build'

label: [Linux] Test suites with build/monica-run
command: direnv exec . cmake --build build --target monica-run && pixi run test --monica build/monica-run --engine linux-debug --out build/test-results
